programme.title: Panda Power - Rise Of Furry Diplomats 第1季
programme.desc: In this episode, we uncover the origins of panda diplomacy, a strategy employed by China, utilising pandas as symbols of goodwill and friendship in international relations.\n \nThe episode showcases the various pivotal moments, from the early 20th century to modern times, when pandas were gifted to other countries. How did pandas play such an important role in softening diplomatic tensions and promoting cultural exchange on a global scale.

programme.title: Panda Power - Rise Of Furry Diplomats 第1季
programme.sub-title: The Race to Breed China’s Pandas
programme.desc:
They’re cute, cuddly and charming, and they’re one of China’s most effective diplomatic tools. We’re talking about pandas.
 
In the past decade, China has been sending pandas around Southeast Asia in an effort to build alliances. In return, countries are pulling out all the stops for these furry diplomats - from building palaces to spending millions on the care and breeding of the pandas.
 
What does this signal about China’s relationship with Southeast Asia.

programme.title: River Walks 第1季
programme.desc: This multi award-winning documentary follows charismatic blind adventurer Amar Latif as he explorers one of Yorkshire’s most stunning river valleys. As a blind man with a passion for outdoor adventure, Amar abseils into a hidden canyon, canoes across a huge reservoir, visits mysterious ruins, goes fishing for trout and meets the local llamas. It’s an uplifting and life-affirming watch as this unique presenter reveals how he takes constant pleasure from the smallest things in rugged landscapes as beautiful as this.

programme.title: River Walks 第1季
programme.desc: Kirsten O’Brien sets off on a spectacular walk along on of Britain’s wildest rivers. In this 15-mile hike along the River Tees near Barnard Castle, Kirsten explores the hidden history of Upper Teesdale. She meets some of extraordinary people who call its banks home and takes a daring wild swim in its white waters.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: Making Pandas 第1季
programme.desc: The iconic Giant Panda is on the brink. With only 1600 left in the wild, pressures on their natural habitat and a notoriously small window for reproduction are edging them towards extinction - fast.\nOver 1 year, we go behind-the-scenes and follow the incredible work of a dedicated group of zookeepers and vets as they race to get Singapore’s famed couple… to fall in ‘love’. \nThe team from the River Safari has a tough road ahead. This film follows the year that Kai Kai and Jia Jia become the focus of attention not just from the general public but from the scientists themselves in the greatest challenge Singapore Zoo has faced yet.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: On a wild and dangerous adventure to Mexico, BMX bikers Rooftop and Catfish test how gutsy they really are. The pair go from racing bikes to racing donkeys, flame throwing and tricking in pointy shoes on the streets, to loosing their breakfast trying to eat eyeball tacos for lunch. But the duo’s bravery (or stupidity) doesn’t end there. They compete in a rodeo, milk a snake for its venom, spin upside down as Voladores in a traditional rain ceremony, and get tattoos right before diving into the city’s toxic sewage. With all of these dauntless activities the question becomes, can Rooftop and Catfish make it out of Mexico in one piece.

programme.title: Strangers In Danger 第1季
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish’s travels take them to Romania, where the daredevil acts continue. After a chariot race in the countryside, the BMX bikers continue their attempt to become Romanian gladiators by flying through the air, jumping through flaming walls, and even lighting themselves on fire while riding their bikes. They get up close and personal with the sheep of the country, trying the Romanian delicacy of sheep’s head, but quickly move on to just milking the animal. Finally, the trip to this Eastern European country is not complete without trying to clean up the streets from Romania’s stray dog epidemic. Are Rooftop and Catfish able to save the strays or does the duo learn that they are all bark and no bite.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -祕密代號之謎

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -紙箱
programme.desc: Hmm all these boxes? What can we do? let's just say we have some 'speedy'' ideas.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -石頭
programme.desc: Hepi and Briko have some solid ideas about what we can make with rocks.

programme.title: 優可 -機器人
programme.desc: When Yoko makes a robot that helps the kids with absolutely everything, they realise that sometimes it's more fun to do things themselves.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -虛擬實境日
programme.desc: The Art Ninja loves to play his favorite virtual reality computer game - Mind Kingdom! But things don't go to plan when Gav becomes addicted and won't give up the headset. Ricky is inspired to make a pinball machine, and there's epic art with a right royal dot-to-dot.

programme.title: 藝術忍者 -舞蹈對決日
programme.desc: Ricky is shocked to discover that his dance battle crew has deserted him. He creates a dance decider and makes a break-dancer from an unusual material. When things get heated between the rival dance troupes, there is only one way to settle it - dance off.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -咖啡濾紙
programme.desc: Who says coffee is the only thing filters are used for? See how we turn this day to day object into something fun.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -小炸彈
programme.desc: Leo is shouting that she is exploding. What is happening to Leo? Is she joining sides with explosion-loving Boom? Everyone is glad to find out that the explosion is simply a case of passing gas.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -巨型影像牆
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents video artists creating massive projections and earbuds that filter out sounds you don't want to hear. She visits scientists growing lungs in a lab and meets a teen trio who whose curiosity led to a breakthrough in speeding up seed growth.

programme.title: 探討有趣新發明 -蜂蜜發明
programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents the best of inventions: a jet ski submarine that flies underwater, a “honey on tap” beehive, a ball game for horses and stone sculptures created using physics.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -雪崩
programme.desc: There's an emergency in Nepal. The snow is melting and is about to cause an avalanche to fall on a village. Only the MeteoHeroes can prevent an environmental catastrophe.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -可怕的廢棄物
programme.desc: Toxic waste has been dumped in a river, destroying all the life in and around the water. Nubess and Pluvia go on a mission to the USA to prevent an environmental catastrophe. Our heroes soon discover that the toxic waste comes from a nearby factory.

programme.title: 地球小尖兵 -海中的植物
programme.desc: Kids try sea plants.

programme.title: 打造貓樂園 -貓計程車
programme.desc: OEistein makes a cardboard cat taxi.

programme.title: 全球探險家霍吉 -霍吉去尼斯湖
programme.desc: Floaty lands on the banks of Loch Ness, where Hogie and his friends meet Duncan, who is training to take part in the Highland Games. Can Hogie help Duncan prepare for the upcoming tournament, and will Lorna find that elusive Nessie.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -童話故事在人間
programme.desc: When Vicky's plan backfires, all teams are sent to Earth for class. The Gingerbread Witch lures them into her bakery, making teams disappear. Rose, Hawk, Travis, and the others spot the witch's cookie minions and leap into action to free their classmates.

programme.title: 神奇小百科 -黏菌會思考嗎
programme.desc: Slime mould are cleverer than they look even though they don't have eyes, a skeleton, a nervous system, or even a brain. They are single-celled organisms. There are more than 900 species of them all over the world.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -水陸交界
programme.desc: Four young adventurers head to West Coast National Park in South Africa and discover a world of seabirds and snakes. Along the way they go canoeing and snorkelling, meet wild animals and learn the value of nature parks.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -沿岸沙漠
programme.desc: Four young adventurers explore Namaqua National Park in South Africa, a desert region with the largest concentration of succulent plants in the world. They learn how to survive in its harsh environment by learning ancient traditions.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -模糊地帶
programme.desc: Kaiko and Will try to examine a glowing fish but fall under its spell. Ant and Fontaine must rescue their parents, wearing blindfolds.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -洛基的城堡
programme.desc: The Nektons take over the Dark Orca submarine. But the pirates take over the Aronnax. No one is happy with having strangers in their homes.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -比武大賽
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, tournaments are all the rage! When Howler's behavior is interpreted of that as a crazed fan, he unwittingly finds himself in the shoes of a knight, embarking on a wild joust.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -中世紀的醫學
programme.desc: Falling sick in the Middle Ages is not a good idea! Dove has trouble finding a cure for Little Lewis when he falls ill. A consultation takes us on a tour of the wacky techniques and beliefs, along with typical treatments used in medieval times.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -爆紅影片
programme.desc: Naomi's makeup blog is a hit, driving Carol and Motor crazy-Carol wants the internet used for good, Motor wants more views on his game page. A viral video contest begins, and even Robbie joins. But in the end, a surprise player creates the video that truly goes viral.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -表兄弟
programme.desc: Robbie's been lying to his cool cousin Bobbie for years to impress him. Now Bobbie's visiting, and Robbie must convince his friends to play along-Carol as his girlfriend, Motor as his best friend, Albert as his bodyguard. But is Bobbie really who he claims to be.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -比武大賽
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, tournaments are all the rage! When Howler's behavior is interpreted of that as a crazed fan, he unwittingly finds himself in the shoes of a knight, embarking on a wild joust.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -電流力學
programme.desc: How do batteries work? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of electricity. Have hands-on fun by making a battery using lemons, and get to know Nikola Tesla, physicist, engineer and inventor, who conceived the modern alternating current supply system.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環保科學和回收
programme.desc: What's the difference between science and green science? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of renewable energy. Have hands-on fun by making your lettuce sustainable, and get to know Ryoji Noyori, a chemist and great advocate of green chemistry.

programme.title: 優可 -瓦瓦湖的怪獸
programme.desc: When Mai loses her racquet in the Lake, Ranger Loops tells the legend of the Monster of Lake Wawa, which has a surprising ending.

programme.title: 優可 -派蒂路普斯
programme.desc: When Ranger Loops brings his niece Patty to visit, the kids help her overcome her shyness to make new friends.

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -重複利用製作之秘密基地
programme.desc: Daddy is vacuuming and the children can't play around. Luckily, Harper decides to reuse old bedsheets, hang them over some chairs and make a den. Inside and outside, the children have found it is simple to create a den and make a space to play.

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -降低螢幕使用時間
programme.desc: The Grimwades decide to reduce screen time by taking a screen break. With their devices stored away in a cardboard box, they go to a sensory garden and experience the here and now by using each of their five senses one by one.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -摺紙盒子
programme.desc: How can you carry stuff with a sheet of paper? See what that paper can hold with a few simple folds.

programme.title: 優可 -生日快樂, 優可
programme.desc: The kids throw a surprise birthday party for Yoko, and hope that their home-made present pleases him..

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -風帆車
programme.desc: How do you make a wind powered wonder wagon? You'll need a paper cup and the power of puff.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅, 第一部
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo do not seem to know that there is a place on Earth where it is not at all polite to open a present in front of the person that gave it to you. Alim suggests bringing his friends to Japan, where they meet Kimiko.

programme.title: 小小致富夢想家 -天使投資者
programme.desc: Max gets a sponsor, but his investment comes with his meddling daughter, who takes over the group. The gang shows her she doesn't need to buy friends.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -噎住的急救步驟
programme.desc: Dr Chris and Dr Xand give First-Aid tips to help save someone from choking. The Ouch-Mobile solves more medical mysteries, and the doctors look back at the best bits of Operation Ouch.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -令人欽佩的水中上將
programme.desc: Eric learns that even if something is made from a material that is denser or heavier than water, it will float if it has the right shape. He makes a paper boat strong enough to carry toy cars without sinking.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -高速神經與髒手
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand reveal the speed of nerves and test a trick to make your favourite cake look bigger. Dr. Xand sees what happens when you don't wash your hands. At the hospital, one patient has a swollen ear, and another has a sweet stuck up their nose.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -秘密訊息
programme.desc: Eric learns that, with a little science, you can bring out all the colours that make up the black ink in felt tip markers. He separates the colours using chromatography. This gives him a way to write secret messages.

programme.title: 體操新星 -友誼的考驗
programme.desc: Best friends Amelie and Phoebe head to Baku to fight against forty-four other European countries to qualify for a spot at the Youth Olympic Games. But if they do manage to qualify, only one gymnast can go. So, with this kind of pressure, can their friendship survive.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -新名字
programme.desc: Can the Junior Vets determine the sex of a very special penguin? Six cute kittens need checkups and new names - meet X-ray, Smudge, and, of course, baby Johnny! And Paul, the rat, has trouble breathing.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -守門員與探險家
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, the world's best field hockey goalkeeper and Olympic gold medallist, Maddie Hinch, and the world's greatest living explorer, Ranulph Fiennes, share their record breaking journeys.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -求生者與老闆
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary, Bear Grylls shares his story of perseverance and how he became 'the world's best known survival expert', while Ursula Burns reflects on her journey to becoming the first Black woman CEO of a Fortune 500 company.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -希望與夢想
programme.desc: The Icicles have made it to the World Synchro Championships and are heading to Canada. After a season of flawless performances, can the girls pull off their Bollywood routine? The end of season Gala is near, but preparations aren't running as smoothly as everyone hoped.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -白努利和同伴
programme.desc: Eric learns how the Bernoulli Principle and playing with the flow of air can help him inflate a plastic bag. This same principle explains how airplanes fly, too.

programme.title: 寵物救援隊 -一步一步來
programme.desc: Will Homer's ultrasound reveal something more sinister lurking beneath? Marisa and trusty sidekick Megan kick into action to save two Labradors with lots of life left to live. And Charlie, the cute kitten, continues his fight for life - one gram at a time.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -繞圈走
programme.desc: Did you know you could draw a perfect circle by using your pinky finger? In this episode we introduce basic geometric constructions and explain the importance of fixed pivot-points. Are you up for the challenge? Eric is.

programme.title: 神秘大探索: 科學DIY -科學博物館
programme.desc: Host Steve Spangler and his sidekick, Higginsworth, visit the Museum of Science in Boston for new DIY science tricks and face the challenge of how to get two hundred and fifty rubber ducks to fly.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -蛋味牙齒
programme.desc: In this episode, the doctors chew disclosing tablets to take a close look at their gnashers - who will have brushed their teeth the best?! And find out what happens to your teeth when you eat and drink with an eggs-cellent experiment.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -膝蓋骨挑戰
programme.desc: There's chaos in the kitchen lab as Baby LiLou joins the doctors to reveal why you need kneecaps. Find out how your knees work with a simple Do Try experiment.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -消失在夕陽下
programme.desc: Have you noticed that some things look further away than others on a flat surface, almost as if they were about to disappear? In this episode we introduce you to the concept of 'perspective', often used by painters to provide depth to objects.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -魔力曲線球
programme.desc: In so called ‘string art', straight lines are drawn that look like curved lines. In this episode, Eric tries to do the same. What mathematical principles form the basis of string art and will Eric succeed.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -放風箏
programme.desc: Have you ever noticed that a kite in geometry looks a lot like a kite in the sky? It's no coincidence. In this episode we join Eric on a high-flying mission to unfurl the secret of symmetry used to make kites fly. Is it magic ... or is it math?

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -離開我的視線
programme.desc: The doctors discover special eye cells and meet a hospital entertainer. Dr. Christ visits a lab where scientists are making blood from stem cells. In the Emergency Department, one patient flies in after cutting her chest, and another hit his head on a goal post.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -神奇數字
programme.desc: In 1949, the mathematician D. R. Kaprekar from India came up with the ‘Kaprekar's operation'. Following three fixed steps, the outcome of this operation is always 6174. How is that possible? We'll find out in this exciting episode.

programme.title: 體操新星 -頂尖對決
programme.desc: It's the day of the British Championships, and our Gym Stars hope they are ready for the competition! Cameron is about to find out if his hectic training schedule will pay off, and Amelie is determined to wow the crowd.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -克服恐懼
programme.desc: Sam and Morgan operate on Gandalf the falcon's lumpy foot. And the Junior Vets are about to find out what real vet work is all about. But will Saira overcome her fear of big dogs to help stray hound Jessie, who needs life-changing surgery.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -神祕的腫塊
programme.desc: The Junior Vets are trying to get to the bottom of Benji the dog's painful pee problem. And Gary, the axolotl, arrives at Vet School with a mysterious lump. Can the Junior Vets work out what's wrong.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -巴哈馬群島
programme.desc: In this episode we join a professional free diver and take a look at the world's deepest saltwater blue hole. After that, we head over to the mangroves to see how local researchers have been tracking baby lemon sharks for decades.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -艾瑞克製造風
programme.desc: Eric learns that an anemometer – an instrument to measure wind speed – is important for sailors and for pilots. Then he learns how to make one himself.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -掠食者迷思
programme.desc: In this episode we join the shark research team at the University of Miami to study sharks. We then head to Florida where Philippe visits an antivenom lab home to hundreds of venomous snakes.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -蟲蟲來襲
programme.desc: Eric learns that insects have a head, thorax, abdomen, antennae, and six legs. He is surprised to find out that spiders are not insects – they are arachnids.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -小丑魚與白虎
programme.desc: We follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more clownfish to come. In the meantime, Lin Mao, the white tiger, has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -壯觀的病菌
programme.desc: Eric discovers that washing your hands can prevent the spread of bacteria. He does an experiment to show how easy it is to spread these tiny germs from person to person.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -肥皂帆船
programme.desc: Eric makes a model boat using soap as fuel. The boat moves because the soap breaks the surface tension of the water, causing the water molecules to repel each other and push each other backwards into the boat.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -鎮上的新男孩
programme.desc: The ice-dancing girls are desperate for boy partners, and new boy Adriano is moving from Italy to Nottingham to find himself a dance partner. Nine-year-old Charlie lives and breathes ice hockey, but has he got what it takes to impress the coach.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -重大的決定
programme.desc: Ice dancer Adriano has finally chosen his new dance partner, so it's time to tell Chloe and Ella who he's picked. And speed skater Maddie loves going fast, but a mysterious illness has affected her training. She has a new plan which she hopes will help her recover.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -非洲之角
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers continue their journey through Mountain Zebra National Park in South Africa. Game rangers teach them about Black Rhinos and White Rhinos and the importance of protecting them.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -金色大門
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers travel by bus, horse and helicopter through Golden Gate Highlands National Park in South Africa. They learn about the origins of the natural world and discover some rock art.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -地層探險
programme.desc: Inspired by digging at the beach, Darwin and Newts hop on board a drilling vehicle to explore the layers of the Earth beneath their feet.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -救救南秧雞
programme.desc: When Heni's new kitten almost catches a flightless bird, Darwin and Newts decide to turn the island into a bird sanctuary.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -大開挖
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts go on a big dig adventure to find dinosaur bones.

programme.title: 優可 -生日快樂, 優可

programme.title: 動物大使館 -貓熊與金剛鸚鵡
programme.desc: Posse, the red panda, and Santiago, the saki, have been having issues with their teeth and the dentist brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue-throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -虎鯨寶寶
programme.desc: Morgan, the deaf orca, is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff at Loro Parque are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅, 第一部
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo do not seem to know that there is a place on Earth where it is not at all polite to open a present in front of the person that gave it to you. Alim suggests bringing his friends to Japan, where they meet Kimiko.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -摩洛哥之旅
programme.desc: Zoe is disgusted when she sees that Alim starts eating the chocolate mousse she prepared without a spoon. Soon after, they travel to Morocco and learn more about the eating customs there.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -奈及利亞之旅
programme.desc: Alim thinks that the criteria for being beautiful are not the same from country to country. To prove that beauty standards vary across cultures, he takes his friends to Nigeria, where, as they speak, a beauty contest is taking place.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -複製
programme.desc: Robbie's wardrobe is accidentally converted into a cloning chamber, and he is quick to take advantage of having an army of himself. The new Robbies, however, have different ideas about who should be in charge.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級降落傘
programme.desc: Eric makes a parachute that will slow down a falling egg just enough so it doesn't get smashed when it hits the ground. But first he experiments to figure out the best parachute size. He discovers that NASA also use parachutes to drop robotic probes on to the moon.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -地下驚奇
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts explore a cave system and discover there's a whole other world underground, with a river, rock formations, and an array of amazing creatures.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -波皮和奇亞的氣球冒險
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts solve the problem of finding out far things by using a balloon-camera to take an aerial photo.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -迷人的化石
programme.desc: Were all dinosaurs reptiles? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of palaeontology. Have hands-on fun by creating a dinosaur egg, and get to know Teuku Jacob, who used fossils and remains to study the origins and predecessors of present human species.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -點亮太陽系

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -動物吸引力
programme.desc: Addison has to find out what's wrong with Mrs. Rorschach's cat, Mr. Tiggles, when he becomes afraid of his own cat toys, especially the new fridge magnet mouse.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -瓶中訊息
programme.desc: When a cryptic message turns up in a bottle in the Ayrton Park wading pool, Alex suspects its from Ancient Egyptians or someone shipwrecked on a desert island – but Addison thinks there must be another explanation.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -如何捕大魚

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -馬賽克大混亂
programme.desc: Doki accidentally breaks Anabella's vintage tea tray and she's mad. Doki wants to make it up to her, but how can he fix her broken tea tray? The team heads to Istanbul, Turkey, where a ‘puzzle solving pro' is putting together fragments of an ancient ruin.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -毛巾

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -繩子
programme.desc: Summertime is here! Hepi and Briko have the perfect plan to re use all this rope we have lying around.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -佐治的一天

programme.title: 動物大使館 -小丑魚與白虎
programme.desc: We follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more clownfish to come. In the meantime, Lin Mao, the white tiger, has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -奇怪的審判
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, animals are considered responsible for their actions and must answer to their crimes in a court of law! A crazy trial takes place, with Howler as the animals' attorney and Roach as the judge and persecutor.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -食物

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -領主與農民
programme.desc: Our humble peasant friend Howler can't wait for his next batch of pretzels! However, in the Middle Ages, the feudal system is ruthless, the lord always helping himself to a share of the peasant's yield. And, quite often, all that's left is a few meager crumbs.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -神祕的融化事件
programme.desc: The Junior Rangers fundraiser is in danger of being shut down.Addison meanwhile is investigating a mysterious case of Tess's melting chocolate statue of herself (causes by mirrors) and is inspired to build a solar cooker to save the day on the weenie roast.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -尋寶記
programme.desc: When a geocached item seems to have disappeared along with the soil it was buried in, Addison is intent on finding out what happened to it.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -T恤
programme.desc: Upcycling old t-shirts to a whole new level, let's just say we make them even more cooler.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -水桶
programme.desc: No place to sit? Do not worry, we have the most creative solution for you.

programme.title: 優可 -馬戲團, 馬戲團

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -珊瑚與礁石
programme.desc: A coral reef exploration goes downhill when Mr. Battery is abducted by an electric stingray.

programme.desc: Flippy and Motor just finished their best track ever and want a video to match. Flippy dreams big-boats, mansions, even space! But Motor suggests something cheaper: animation. With help from friends, they set out to make a music video that's going to be so cool.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -乾燥的葉子

programme.title: 冰上新星 -重新上路
programme.desc: The Icicles are taking a huge risk and have choreographed a very ambitious routine. Charlie and Freddie are off to a competition in Guildford via Grandma's house for a sleepover. And a talented young skater from Russia has got everyone in a spin.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -瘋狂坑洞
programme.desc: Eric learns that most asteroids burn out before they reach our planet. But sometimes, when they're super huge, they hit Earth and make really big craters. He does an experiment to show what would happen in that situation.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -來自星星

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -由內往外看

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -沒有恐懼的餘地
programme.desc: Today, Sam and Saira must face their fears as they are called to the zoo to take a blood sample from Bob and Bindi - a pair of very snappy West African dwarf crocodiles. And Tuppence, the one-eyed Jack Russell, needs high-tech radiation therapy treatment.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -雙重緊急事件
programme.desc: There's a double emergency at the Vet School. Edward, the ferret, is seriously ill, having stopped eating, and a sick cow with a mystery illness needs investigating. Can the Junior Vets cope when things go wrong.

programme.desc: This week we visit South Carolina where Philippe tags tiger sharks in Port Royal Sound, spots wild venus fly traps, and examines ecosystem indicators through three different species of crab.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密度強度

programme.desc: We delve into the world of satellites: from small cube-sized ones all the way up to large space crafts that orbit the Earth. Emily visits one of the largest satellite manufacturers in the world to see how satellites are made and tested for the rigors of outer space.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -洗澡時的皺皮膚
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand try to find out why skin goes wrinkly in the bath. Dr. Chris meets a patient taking part in amazing heart research. The doctors do a mind-bending trick, and at the hospital, one patient has a sore head and another has dislocated her jaw.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -刺激的聲音
programme.desc: Eric learns how sound waves work in the air and in water. Then he does an experiment to make sound waves travel along a piece of string.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -實際證明
programme.desc: Eric juggles three different kinds of balls: a baseball, a tennis ball, and a bouncy rubber ball. Then he does a scientific experiment to see which one can bounce the highest.

programme.title: 體操新星 -封城大戰
programme.desc: Acro gymnasts Dylan and Nyree have come up with a special lockdown competition, and all the Gym Stars are getting involved.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -GOAT與賽車手
programme.desc: In this episode of Becoming Xtraordinary presented by Bear Grylls, tennis legend, French Open, and Grand Slam winner, Roger Federer, and the world's most successful woman in Indy car racing, Danica Patrick, share their stories on becoming the best in the world.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密碼
programme.desc: Eric learns that computer coding means writing programmes that tell robots and computers how to do certain jobs. Just as we use language to communicate with other people, there are lots of different programming or 'coding' languages to talk to computers.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -下雪時間
programme.desc: Figure skaters Josh, Kloe, and Beccy pack their bags and head to Latvia for an important international competition. But it's not all snowball fights and fun. Josh is moving into the senior category and has decided to attempt a new jump.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -驚人的神經元
programme.desc: Eric learns that neurons are the brain's tiny building blocks. He does an experiment to show what they are and how they work. He is surprised to learn that giraffes have neurons that are five metres long.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -雞殺手
programme.desc: Chip, the dog, is struggling to walk - can a new hip ease his pain? The Junior Vets give some flamingos a foot rub and check on a baby emu. Also, Johnny and Inel learn about the birds and the bees and investigate whether Jasper, the cat, really is a chicken killer.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -美人魚
programme.desc: Ant is determined to find out what the mermaid-shaped thing is swimming outside the Aronnax. The search leads him straight to the pirates.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -下巴的力量與幫助思考的食物
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand reveal the amazing strength of your jaw and get cooking with the hospital chefs. Dr Xand goes to the Ear Nose & Throat department and Dr. Chris does his last Ouch & About On Call. In the Emergency Room, someone cut their foot on a tin lid.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -星星之力
programme.desc: In this episode, we use the kirigami method to make our own pentagram: the 5-pointed star famous for being a magical symbol. If Eric can do it, you can do it, too! It's not magic ... it's math.

programme.title: 體操新星 -友誼的考驗
programme.desc: Best friends Amelie and Phoebe head to Baku to fight against forty-four other European countries to qualify for a spot at the Youth Olympic Games. But if they do manage to qualify, only one gymnast can go. So, with this kind of pressure, can their friendship survive.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -時間緊迫
programme.desc: Today, the Junior Vets have to look after squealing piglets, get uncomfortably close to a giant horse that is having an internal examination, and do health checks on tiny homeless kittens.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -重大手術
programme.desc: The Junior Vets have got one day's experience under their belts. Today a wild boar needs the Junior Vets' help, a tiny dog goes in a massive scanner, and a snotty cow is having heavy surgery.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級降落傘
programme.desc: Eric makes a parachute that will slow down a falling egg just enough so it doesn't get smashed when it hits the ground. But first he experiments to figure out the best parachute size. He discovers that NASA also use parachutes to drop robotic probes on to the moon.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -風箏把戲
programme.desc: Eric builds a new kite. He makes sure it is symmetrical – both sides are exactly the same – as that helps kites fly and stay balanced in the air. He learns that there are lots of different types of kites but they all need the wind to fly.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -天然災害
programme.desc: Philippe visits the University of Miami to check out a lab that can simulate a category 5 hurricane. At the University of Reno he explores the so called 'shake table' that designs buildings that can hold up during earthquakes.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -折射上的反射
programme.desc: Eric does a fun experiment to show how refraction plays tricks with our eyes. He learns that when we look at objects, we see the light reflected from them. Because light doesn't travel as well through water as it does through air, things in water look different to us.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -振翅飛舞
programme.desc: Philippe visits the Congaree National Park in South Carolina where he catches and tags local bats. Later, he studies the flight patterns of wood storks and examines the magical transition from caterpillar to butterfly.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -秘密訊息
programme.desc: Eric learns that, with a little science, you can bring out all the colours that make up the black ink in felt tip markers. He separates the colours using chromatography. This gives him a way to write secret messages.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -彩繪白努利
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make an airbrush out of straws. Thanks to the Bernoulli principle, he uses it to create his own work of art.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -三、二、一...升空
programme.desc: The chemical reaction that takes place in the engines of a real rocket produces a large amount of very hot gas that makes the rocket lift off into the sky. Eric mixes baking powder and water to create a chemical reaction strong enough to launch a toy rocket.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -滑冰超能力
programme.desc: Alexia and Kloe are off to London to meet Dr. Xand and the Operation Ouch team to see if a scientist can figure out why they don't get dizzy when they spin. Izzy has a very important speed trial to see if she has what it takes to join the Olympic squad.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -宴會日
programme.desc: It's the day of the gala. As the crowds arrive, there's drama backstage. Will Ella fix her costume in time for her big debut with Adriano? Will Kloe keep her nerves under control and nail her Hungarian performance? A surprising performance leaves everyone speechless.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 野性岬角 -德胡普: 希望之地
programme.desc: The explorers search a colony of rare and endangered vultures that live high in the secluded mountains of the Western Cape. They come upon a refuge for animals, where unexpectedly they catch a glimpse of the largest mammal on the planet.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 野性岬角 -古卡馬: 最後的荒野
programme.desc: While exploring the picturesque Garden Route, the Zebrabus stumbles onto a hidden retreat with some of the highest vegetated dunes in South Africa. They face snakes and other reptiles before venturing out to sea in search of sharks.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -大溪地之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo have a presentation to prepare for school, and they are scratching their heads to find the most original way to do this. Our friends travel to Tahiti, where they meet with Amana and learn more about telling a story through dance.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅, 第二部
programme.desc: Our heroes prepare for a sleepover in the HQ, but it seems impossible to divide the space, so they each have a separate bedroom. Alim knows of places where people feel more comfortable sleeping together in the same room. Everyone is soon in Japan for a new adventure.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -馬利之旅
programme.desc: Milo is trying to learn his poem but is having a hard time remembering the words. Alim thinks it is easier to learn something while listening to music! Zoe and Milo do not seem convinced, and Alim decides that only a short break to Mali could change this.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -加納利群島之旅
programme.desc: Is it possible to communicate over a distance with neither telephone nor internet access? A little trip to the Canary Islands could answer the question. With the help of their penfriend Kiko, our friends will learn to use the landscape to communicate with others.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -請注意
programme.desc: Robbie and Flippy are sent to the Principal for messing around, and become subjects of a new experiment in behaviour-control.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -風箏把戲
programme.desc: Eric builds a new kite. He makes sure it is symmetrical – both sides are exactly the same – as that helps kites fly and stay balanced in the air. He learns that there are lots of different types of kites but they all need the wind to fly.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -歡樂下雨天
programme.desc: After a day of mud sliding, the kids have to problem solve when heavy rain endangers some of the Kiwifruit Valley creatures.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -紙飛機的難題
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts learn about the different shapes of paper planes, and then have to help Heni rescue Burpee from the top of a tree.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -寫程式和編碼
programme.desc: How did people compute before the invention of computers? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of computing. Have hands-on fun by making your own abacus, and get to know Ada Lovelace, the first computer programmer before the invention of computers.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -瘋狂的催化劑
programme.desc: What is a catalyst? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of chemical engineering. Have hands-on fun by producing your own cheese, and get to know Ryong Ryoo, who discovered a rock trapping water inside it can serve as catalyst in petrochemicals.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -無頭獵人之謎
programme.desc: Addison has to solve the mystery of what's making scary sounds after Donnie convinces the other kids on an Ayrton Rangers camping trip that a mythical spook called the Headless Haunter is wandering through the park.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -惡毒的蚊子之謎
programme.desc: When swarms of mosquitoes mysteriously descend on the park, the kids' summer movie night is in danger of being cancelled unless Addison and her friends can figure out a way to stop them.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -迷宮之旅
programme.desc: After Doki tells the story of Theseus and the labyrinth, Mundi boasts about her natural sense of direction. Gabi thinks Mundi relies on her ability to fly! To prove her skill, Mundi suggests they visit a hedge maze in Cumbria, England.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇的海豚
programme.desc: Fico has decided that the ideal pet for him is a dolphin. At first, everyone finds this ridiculous, but then gets excited. The team flies to the coast of Australia to find one. After all, why can't Fico have a dolphin.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -咖啡濾紙
programme.desc: Who says coffee is the only thing filters are used for? See how we turn this day to day object into something fun.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -粉蠟筆
programme.desc: Colouring isn't the only thing these crayons are good at! Join Hepi and Briko as they blow your mind with creative and colourful DIYs.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -中世紀的衛生習慣
programme.desc: Howler isn't exactly a paragon of cleanliness! But seeing as he's got a soft spot for Dove, he needs to step up the hygiene if he wants to win her heart! So he introduces us to various medieval hygiene techniques.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -傻人節
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, life may be tough, but having fun is also on the agenda! Folly Festival is a carnival where everyone sings and dances, but also has fun trading places. Howler becomes a princess for the day, and Little Lewis a lord.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -騎士們
programme.desc: Little Lewis follows every step in order to achieve his dream. After completing a plethora of thankless tasks at a young age, he moves on to the rank of ‘squire.' A chance to demonstrate his bravery on the battlefield, in order to be knighted, at last.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -奇特的硬幣之謎
programme.desc: Addison and Alex dig up what they think is an Ancient Roman coin in the community garden – then have a mystery to solve when it unexpectedly disappears.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -搶先報導
programme.desc: When Addison and her classmates get a school assignment to write about local news – and the news is that laundry is going missing from balconies around Ayrton Park – Addison turns into investigative reporter to crack the case and get a scoop.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -地球日
programme.desc: Let's celebrate this wonderful planet we call home! Make sure to remember our 3 Rs.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -麵粉
programme.desc: Ahh something smells so good, what is it? Oh it's Hepi and Briko's fresh new ideas! What are they up to now.

programme.title: 優可 -小小事物
programme.desc: When the kids lose a toy, Yoko shrinks them down to toy size so they can find it.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -超大號里歐
programme.desc: Sprinter feels bad that Leo is so small. He builds her a machine that alters the size of things. Leo is, after all, fine being small. Sprinter could learn by looking at things from another perspective.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -消失無蹤
programme.desc: When Leo disappears, Bumble has to help Sprinter find her. All traces lead to Cleopatra, but she won`t admit anything. Soon, Bumble goes missing too! Sprinter realises that the only solution is to let himself get caught.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -鑽油平台
programme.desc: A visit to an oil platform leads to an accident that Kit and Mr. Battery must set right.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海嘯
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery fight the albatross for the stolen safety buoys.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -神話與傳說
programme.desc: After taking care of his daily chores, Howler ‘gets away from it all' by daydreaming about wonderful encounters! In the process, he takes us through various contemporary beliefs, myths and legends, powered by his very rich imagination.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -泰國之旅
programme.desc: Is there a country where even toddlers happily eat the spiciest dishes? Our heroes travel to Thailand to find out. And Alim's penfriend Narawan prepares a spicy meal.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -加拿大之旅
programme.desc: Everybody knows that at school you learn about letters and numbers, history, poetry, and lots of other things. But in Canada, at school, you can also learn about fishing. It's time for another trip. And, of course, we will meet one of Alim's penfriends - Sakari.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -瑞典之旅
programme.desc: Zoe has just made sweets of different colours, but they are salty! Milo has confused the sugar dispenser with the salt dispenser. Sweets are not supposed to be savoury! But in some places, salty sweets are popular. And, off they go to Sweden.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -伊朗之旅
programme.desc: Zoe has to make some complicated calculations, but she has no electronic device at hand that could help her with that, so she is in a bit of a panic. Milo does not seem to have an answer. As for Alim, he sees the solution to her problems in a trip to Iran.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -午夜的12聲鐘響
programme.desc: It's the New Year celebration, and everybody brings a traditional dish. On this occasion, Mily learns that Kun, Hamid and several of her friends celebrate the New Year at a different time.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -快樂
programme.desc: Mily wants to play the guitar with her big brother Luc. As the day progresses, she will learn the difference between instant gratification and lasting happiness.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -英雄養成學校
programme.desc: It's hard to be the only superhero, and in an attempt to share the responsibilities, Sprinter starts a school to train more heroes. However, when the villains suddenly show up on the field, the students have to take a very early exam.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -贏家獨裁索爾
programme.desc: DiktaThor has always dreamed of having power over Bhilka. Suddenly it happens and he takes control over Bhilka. But is it a dream that came true, or is it a nightmare.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -探索工程
programme.desc: How do simple building elements create architecture? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of construction. Have hands-on fun by building your own tower, and get to know Fazlur Rahman Khan, who came up with the ‘tube' structure in skyscraper design.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -天啊!天文學
programme.desc: How do rockets manage to defy gravity? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of astronomy. Have hands-on fun by launching your own rocket, and get to know Edwin Hubble, an astronomer, who proved the universe consists of entire galaxies and is expanding.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -蘭波與瘋狂賽車
programme.desc: Lampo wants to join the Meow Meow Grand Prix, the biggest motorbike race in town. The problem is, he doesn't have a bike! Luckily, the mechanic cat Wrench builds him a special bike! Will Lampo win the race and beat the tricky Boss.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -預備起
programme.desc: Joe and Uncle Jack help Flo repaint her dinghy as Morris shows off. There's a race to Granny's between Flo and Joe's dinghies. Joe's boat is ahead when Morris falls overboard. He is rescued. Flo's dinghy wins the race. For once Ebb has outshone Morris.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -埋藏的寶藏
programme.desc: The last clue leads our heroes to a silent snowy graveyard where they dig up more skeletons than they can handle. The mysterious red cloak villain is revealed, and Kelly must face her past to move ahead.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -海底女巫之歌
programme.desc: Rose wants to learn to sing, because all of the great fairy tale princess could sing. Things get tricky when the Sea Witch steals Rose's voice! Rose has to sing in front of the whole school, as Hawk and the others fight to get her voice back in time for her debut.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -領主與農民
programme.desc: Our humble peasant friend Howler can't wait for his next batch of pretzels! However, in the Middle Ages, the feudal system is ruthless, the lord always helping himself to a share of the peasant's yield. And, quite often, all that's left is a few meager crumbs.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -食物
programme.desc: Unlike life in our modern society, in the Middle Ages, people don't eat their fill every day. We follow our foodie Howler as he scavenges around for anything that takes his fancy, overstepping his mark as a mere peasant.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -獅子問題
programme.desc: When Doki boasts about taming a lion, it seems a harmless fib until he's contacted by a friend of the Worldwide Expedition Club with a lion problem. Now Doki has to back up his boast - but how can he help with a lion problem? It's off to Nairobi, Kenya, to find out.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -法敕警察
programme.desc: After a most cruel reign, Emperor Ashoka wanted to get himself some good karma. He decided to spread good throughout India, with the help of his stern 'joy police'. With Ashoka, happiness was no laughing matter.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -瑜伽探源
programme.desc: Yoga dates back to antiquity! Ancient India paved the way with its demanding and, to say the least, athletic practices. Howler, an apprentice yogi, sorely lacks the discipline to match the wisdom of Master Roach.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -艾斯特的一天
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with - especially on her Segway! And when a normal day includes alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods, you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -巴拿馬
programme.desc: Panama City adventure: Explored the iconic Panama Canal, rainforest boat ride, aerial tram above treetops, learned the traditional cumbia dance, and explored the cultural gems of Casco Viejo with local teens. A week of diverse experiences in Central America.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -夏威夷
programme.desc: Hawaii island-hopping: Lava exploration on the Big Island by land and sea with local teens, muddy ATV ride in Kauai, and cultural insights at a lively luau. A week of thrilling adventures and Hawaiian traditions.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -鑽油平台
programme.desc: A visit to an oil platform leads to an accident that Kit and Mr. Battery must set right.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海嘯
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery fight the albatross for the stolen safety buoys.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -神話與傳說
programme.desc: After taking care of his daily chores, Howler ‘gets away from it all' by daydreaming about wonderful encounters! In the process, he takes us through various contemporary beliefs, myths and legends, powered by his very rich imagination.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -波羅的海的異象
programme.desc: Ant finds a mysterious box. But a swarm of rabidly voracious “things” emerge, chasing him.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -往上流的水
programme.desc: Eric does a magic trick that defies the laws of gravity. Then he learns how to make water flow upwards using a science experiment involving flowers and capillary action.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -夢境
programme.desc: Jessi shares a strange dream, and Naomi uses her dream app to decode it. Soon, everyone's sharing wild dreams-except Robbie, who admits he only has nightmares. With Motor's “In Dreams” machine, the gang dives in to help Robbie experience his first real dream ever.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -倒數
programme.desc: Everyone's hooked on a new game dodging falling fruit-except Carol. But when she tries it, she's amazing! She climbs the leaderboard and wins a strange watch. Cool... until giant fruit starts falling on her in real life. This is no ordinary prize-it's game on.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -大教堂
programme.desc: If you want a cathedral, you'd better not be in a hurry! The construction site is a village in its own right, and lasts for several generations! Foreman Howler shows us round a medieval construction site, providing us with a 101 on cathedral-building techniques.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -大家來衝浪
programme.desc: Surf's up in Kiwifruit Valley, and Newts is determined to learn to surf like Heni. But one day the waves are huge and the next day they're gone and the kids have to figure out why.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -搖搖晃晃的吊車
programme.desc: When a raging river moves the bridge, Darwin and Newts must learn about counterweights so they can build a crane to reach out and retrieve it.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -腎的清潔能力
programme.desc: The doctors check out the cleaning power of our kidneys, and the Ouch-Mobile is open for medical mysteries. Dr Xand tries out some vision-shifting spectacles. In the emergency room, one patient has an unusual break in his leg, and another has a stone stuck in his ear.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -願原力與你同在
programme.desc: Eric learns about tiny electrons and how they are connected to creating static electricity. Then he rubs his head with a balloon to create his own static electricity, and uses this to move an object without touching it.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -絕妙的五感體驗
programme.desc: Eric is blindfolded and has to figure out what a mystery object is using his other four senses – hearing, taste, touch and smell. He learns that although most animals have the same senses people do, they use them differently.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -迷失的鯨魚

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -總統與開拓者
programme.desc: In this episode of Bear Grylls' Becoming Xtraordinary, former President of South Africa and Nobel Peace Prize winner President F.W. de Klerk and first Black woman member of the British Government and pioneering British diplomat Valerie Amos share their life lessons.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -鎮上的新男孩
programme.desc: The ice-dancing girls are desperate for boy partners, and new boy Adriano is moving from Italy to Nottingham to find himself a dance partner. Nine-year-old Charlie lives and breathes ice hockey, but has he got what it takes to impress the coach.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -三、二、一...升空
programme.desc: The chemical reaction that takes place in the engines of a real rocket produces a large amount of very hot gas that makes the rocket lift off into the sky. Eric mixes baking powder and water to create a chemical reaction strong enough to launch a toy rocket.

programme.title: 寵物救援隊 -救援與復原
programme.desc: Gemma holds her breath and nose as Slab, the Staffy, goes under the knife. Two newly rehomed Labradors dish out the love and the licks. And Marisa rescues a three-legged tomcat.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -一隻鳥!一隻魚!是變態
programme.desc: In this episode mathemagician Eric turns a bird turn into a fish! In order to understand his shape- shifting trick, we learn all about Escher's metamorphosis: the illusion of one animal slowly transforming into another, line by line.

programme.title: 神秘大探索: 科學DIY -科學展覽
programme.desc: When Higginsworth panics about his science fair project, Steve Spangler gives him practical and fun ways to excel. They demonstrate how to shoot a soda geyser and prove that toast always lands butter-side-down.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -跌破眼鏡
programme.desc: In this episode, the kitchen lab has been turned upside down as Dr. Xand gives the optic nerves of the world the day off. And find out how to make your own eye-popping, brain-teasing game.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室: 請在家嘗試 -濕軟的胃
programme.desc: In this episode, the doctors use a camera pill to reveal how your stomach squidges your food during digestion and get ready to rummage in your fruit bowl, as Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand show you how to make a fake stomach in today's experiment.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -數學無處不在
programme.desc: This episode explores mathematical patterns in nature, such as the tessellating hexagonal units of a honeycomb, the bilateral symmetry of a leaf, and the radial symmetry of a snowflake and spider web. Math really is everywhere.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -反映鏡像書寫
programme.desc: Mirror, mirror on the wall, can you read Eric's handwriting at all? In this episode Eric explores mirror writing: a reversed way of writing seen on for instance ambulances, where the word 'AMBULANCE' is often written in a mirrored way.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -神奇數字
programme.desc: In 1949, the mathematician D. R. Kaprekar from India came up with the ‘Kaprekar's operation'. Following three fixed steps, the outcome of this operation is always 6174. How is that possible? We'll find out in this exciting episode.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -蠍子醫生
programme.desc: The Doctors go head to head in a baking competition to show why your neck needs to twist! There's questions galore from the wards in Ouch & About, and Dr Xand meets a scorpion with medical skills.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -跳脫框架
programme.desc: In this episode Eric uses an innovative approach to get out of a sticky situation. He uses scrumptious strawberry jam on toast, lots of creative thinking and puppets to act out the problem. How can you apply Eric's techniques to your own life.

programme.title: 體操新星 -岌岌可危

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -重要檢查

programme.title: 鄉村空屋大進擊 第3季
programme.desc: Despite the intense summer heat, Na-rae brings a crowd to Palbok-dong while loudly promoting the area. But of cours, things don't go as planned. The team changes plans and heads to Deokjin Park instead.

programme.title: 餐桌上的傳奇
programme.desc: Buddy visits two restaurants that thrive on recipes handed down through generations. First, he heads to Mamoun's Falafel, then off to Nashville to visit Silver Sands Cafe.

programme.title: 戰痘醫師: 肌膚風暴
programme.desc: Tierra is a musician with massive bumps on her ears that hold her back from performing. Dr. Zoe assists Dr. Lee in helping Ryan, whose numerous head bumps undermine his life journey.

programme.title: 墮下的陰謀
programme.desc: Nicole learns that her stepfather suffered a deadly fall down the stairs and her mother has been arrested for his murder. As Nicole begins investigating, she learns that everything is not as it seems.

programme.title: 孤獨狂迷殺機
programme.desc: Romance sparks when a lonely true crime fan meets her favourite podcast host, but things soon turn strange and his newest run of episodes appear to revolve around her eventual murder.

programme.title: 美味公路之旅2
programme.desc: From Seoul to Busan, this spectacular eating show takes place at famous bakeries/patisseries to give the dessert lovers the glimpse of tasty goodness of some of the most-coveted desserts of all.

programme.title: 「僵屍房」大改造 第6季
programme.desc: A zombie in an upscale neighborhood appears welcoming from the outside, but years of water damage, black growth, and a battered roof, will really put Dolmar, Keisha and Amanda to the test.

programme.title: 鄉村空屋大進擊 第3季
programme.desc: After the chaos, afternoon business begins-only to be met with an unexpected torrential downpour in Palbok-dong. Min-seok's team, the most vulnerable to the rain, faces an emergency.

programme.title: 粵菜大師
programme.desc: Masters of Cantonese Cuisine is a documentary on Lingnan (Guangdong) delicacies culture, originally created by Shenzhen Satellite TV. This is a brief history of food belonging to the Greater Bay Area, a history of customs and culture that belongs exclusively to Guangdong. The program focus on the local Guangdong delicacies, and led by a “delicacy searcher”, walking through streets in search of local specialities, visiting masters of Cantonese cuisines, and sharing unique tasting commentaries. In the meantime, the reflection on delicacies would be brought back to live studio, and two observers who are proficient in Cantonese cuisine cultures will have chats on tasting. From a spoon and a drop, it will extend to the taste of life and origin of culture embedded in the delicacies.

programme.title: 優遊記
programme.desc: 【盲盒旅行團】尋找信任與慢活的座標. 黎展峯Andy再次接受盲盒挑戰——憑數張即影即有相片，搜尋遍佈坪洲島上的街坊櫈及共享健身單車，並到訪一間獨立小書店，了解坪洲因獨有地理空間而形成的社區文化。Andy最後會到訪島上唯一小學聖家學校，與不同族裔的學生大玩估語言遊戲，從中感受坪洲的慢活哲學，反思工作與生活的平衡。. 【都市漫遊】廢墟中的文藝復興. 荒廢三十五年的坪洲戲院，在有心人推動下重開大門。書店店主阿傑與街坊營運坪洲戲院，策劃成充滿活力的社區市集與展覽場地，延續昔日的街坊娛樂功能，並由此探討坪洲如何成為吸引自由工作者進駐的「磁石」，在保留生活品質的同時尋找創作靈感，展現追求心靈喘息空間的生活模式。. 【地膽導賞團】第二生命的延續. 坪洲曾是工業重鎮，如今工業式微，原居民Sherry將昔日污染嚴重的廢棄牛皮廠，用回收物料改造成充滿奇思妙想的「秘密花園」，成為島上獨一無二的藝文聚腳點。. 另一邊廂，相機收藏家小林因緣際會移居坪洲，開設小小的菲林相機店。他不為牟利，只視店舖為分享故事的空間，為過千部珍藏尋找「第二生命」，展現坪洲人知足常樂的生活態度，以及在快門聲中「一秒即一世」的情懷。. 【旅遊達人同你傾】昆士蘭餵野生海豚抱樹熊林中漂流. 澳洲是生態旅遊勝地，Mike Yuen就曾參與不同的動物之旅，包括在Moreton Island的沙灘親手餵野生海豚，去大堡礁上天下海漫步海底看壯麗珊瑚，去野生動物收容中心抱抱樹熊，統統既感動，又體會澳洲對生態保育的重視。. Mike Yuen去昆士蘭深親，因此有機會探遊較少遊客的景點，例如開恩茲的樹林漂流體驗、黃金海岸的避世海灘等。. 主持：李凱翹Kay. 嘉賓主持：袁竣鋒Mike.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.sub-title: 大潭郊野公园的日与夜
programme.desc: 人生活的地方，可以和自然环境靠近。这是大潭郊野公园的其中一个特色。. 其实，大潭郊野公园位于港岛东部，面积占香港岛的五分之一。内有四个水塘，由一条大潭水务文物径连系。. 沿着文物径，当中不少的水务设施，都已经被评定为法定古迹。例如由花岗石建造的石桥和水坝，都有过百年历史.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: The legend of Hong Kong aviation began in 1925 when pilot Harry Abbott established a private flying school at Kai Tak Bund in Kowloon Bay and took to the skies for the first time, writing the prologue for Hong Kong's civil aviation. In 1998, Hong Kong Airport relocated to Chek Lap Kok, and the three-runway system has since been completed. Looking ahead, the airport will develop the "Skytopia" airport city, redefining the airport as a new urban core. From humble gravel runways to an international aviation hub, Hong Kong Airport has witnessed a city's flying dream and written a century-old story of connecting the world.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.desc: Indians emphasize family life and attach a particular importance to the education of their children. Living in Hong Kong where the language and culture are so different, what are their thoughts and ideas about education?. Manoj Dhar used to work in the banking industry. He and his wife noticed that many non-Chinese speaking students from underprivileged families in Hong Kong could only enroll in schools mainly for non-Chinese speaking students, making it hard to learn Chinese properly, which in turn limits their upward social mobility. In 2014, they opened a non-profit making education centre, hoping to reshape life with knowledge. They are opening a kindergarten to serve more students. . Herdip Kaur was born and raised in Hong Kong, and is now a teacher in an international kindergarten. Herdip attended a non-Chinese speaking school when she was small, so she can only understand and speak Cantonese, but is not able to read or write Chinese, which has affected her career development. She therefore sent her children to local mainstream schools, hoping they would truly settle in. Besides being a parent and a teacher, Herdip is the only Indian kindergarten manager in Hong Kong. What does she think about the educational philosophies of Indian Hongkongers of different generations and backgrounds.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.desc: 這集特輯向大家介紹亞特蘭大芭蕾舞家塔拉‧李，由她道出在古典芭蕾舞團工作的生活日常；還有編舞大師蘿莉‧史塔琳斯的理念與協作項目，與蘿莉合作的音樂大師兼亞特蘭大樂團指揮羅伯特.史伯諾。另外，也採訪了著名塗鴉藝術家達斯博士、以及由塗鴉界步入純藝術的漢斯。最後，節目又追蹤了「儀表板」這個二人女子組合，如何尋找富有特色的地方，並把其改造為獨一無二、讓非傳統藝術家革新創作的空間。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年5月13日 星期二晚，10時30分 Following the 6 degrees of separation one artist introduces us to the next, each showing the world their Atlanta, it strength of creative collaboration and comraderie. We are introduced to the Atlanta Ballet by ballerina Tara Lee, to the amazing life of a classical ballet institute, the breath of choreographer and collaboration of Laurie Stallings and GLO in the Goat Farm, who introduces us to Maestro and Conducter of the Atlanta Symphony Robert Spano, and Dr. Dax on the other hand a famed graffiti artist, then to HENSE a grafitti artist who is now famed as a fine artist and finally DASHBOARD, a duo team who transform unique spaces to create unique artwork for non-traditional artists Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.5.13 TUE 10:30pm.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.desc: 按照六度分隔理論，透過藝術家接連的介紹，我們將認識到亞特蘭大藝術世界的全貌，以及當中人物的協助關係。首先登場的是市長辦公室文化創意總監卡美拉.羅素.洛芙，她介紹我們認識自成一格的現代藝術家法克穆.佩庫，佩庫又向我們介紹亞特蘭大的士高音樂的教父級大師DJ凱米特，他向我們講解錄製「亞特蘭大之聲」的過程。此外，「七台劇院」的米高哈弗蒂向我們講解亞特蘭大的劇場演出，還有艾里略街酒吧的馬克.積及和艾殊莉.塞策爾，向大家介紹卡斯爾伯里高地的藝術場景。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年5月13日 星期二晚，11時00分 Following the 6 degrees of separation one artist introduces us to the next, each showing the world their Atlanta, it strength of creative collaboration and comraderie. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.5.13 TUE 11:00pm.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: Amy Lo 盧慧敏出生於哥斯達黎加，在香港長大，是中哥混血兒，她在大學期間被發掘成為模特兒，期後開始拍攝劇集、電影，2025年正式進軍樂壇，獲得多個新人獎項。這位多棲的樂壇新鮮人帶著兩首新作《粉月》和《綠縈》登陸《港樂．講樂》，以優美歌聲向觀眾自我介紹。. 主持. 崔潔彤. 林沚羿. 歌曲：. 《粉月》. 《綠縈.

前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第九集: 聯眾銀行遭受巨額騙貸
programme.desc: 汶琥集團董事長被捕的消息被爆出，疑似遭受巨額騙貸的聯眾銀行股價大跌。在總行的會議上，林強展示了匿名郵箱發給他的資訊以及自己查證的內容，證據直指銀行人員與汶琥集團內外勾連。林強之後拜訪錢才，詢問其與汶琥集團案是否有關。錢才否認，並勸林強調查到此為止.

programme.title: 前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第十集: 幕後黑手操縱林強
programme.desc: 聽證會上，羅莎堅稱汶琥集團貸款手續齊全，案件爆雷實際為他人陷害。羅莎被相關部門帶走調查前，與陳行遠進行最後的談話。羅莎指明，正是陳行遠引導和操縱林強一步步揭發了這早已不是秘密的一切。而陳行遠曝光真相的目的，同樣是為了自己的私心.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.sub-title: (A) 時裝的樂趣 (B) 歡迎紅粉熊
programme.desc: A)莉莉、麗麗及緋緋決定設計衣服然後舉辦時裝表演，但緋緋設計的裙子卻在表演中途不慎弄破了，最後她決定改裝裙子，令它更加完美漂亮.

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.desc: 夢安榮獲了春江市十大影響力女性的殊榮，頒獎禮在周末舉行。瑞秋將夢安獲獎的事在公司大肆宣傳，為夢安造勢，夢安卻覺得太過高調，瑞秋則堅定的認為，只有關注了她頭上的榮譽，才不會過度關注她的肚子.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: Stephanie Villaeba Gurung 今年26歲，是在香港出生的尼泊爾和菲律賓混血兒。Stephanie爸爸從小安排她就讀本地學校的華語班。大學期間，她修讀英語語言文學，這段經歷加深了她對文化研究和寫作的興趣。現在她在不同學校教文化及語言課題，還和其他多元族裔朋友一齊以廣東話主持播客節目。. 今集Stephanie會和大家分享自己對身份認同和多元文化的感受。還會和主持Carmen、Vita一齊來個美食比賽.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第三集：劉銘巨額債務連累羅英子
programme.desc: 韓之通催促羅英子寫好辯護詞，然而羅英子在會見當事人後，認為王大福案有可疑，決定要用剩餘的時間調查當事人沒有殺人的證據。此時，羅英子收到丈夫劉銘巨額欠債的追討，質問公婆劉銘借私人貸的事，卻碰冷釘子。她將事情告知師姐邱華，並拜託她幫忙尋找王大福案的證據.

programme.title: 香港故事 - 尾巴會說話
programme.desc: 在光明與黑暗交疊的世界裡，導盲犬是視障人士忠心的守護者，牽引他們走過人生的荊棘滿途，編織成一個關於忠誠和希望的故事。. 拉布拉多犬Gabe從出生開始，他的生命註定不凡，經過嚴謹的篩選，他被選中成為導盲犬，開啟了他的使命之旅。本片將會由她從幼犬到受訓練開始記錄，見證Gabe如何學會陪伴視障人士，成為他們生活中的光明使者。過程中，Gabe不僅接受了服從、導航、危險識別等複雜技能的培訓，更經歷了與訓練員之間深厚感情的建立，見證人犬情誼溫暖人心。. 隨著Gabe的訓練接近尾聲，他即將步入畢業典禮，與自己的視障夥伴進行配對。從陌生到熟悉，他們的每一次接觸、每一刻相處，都在重新定義信任與依靠的意義。視障人士的故事令人心碎，他們曾因失去視力而對生活感到絕望，然而導盲犬的出現，讓他們重新擁抱人生。冷冰冰的手杖被溫暖的毛髮代替。每一次步伐的穩定，每一次停下的等待，在導盲犬的陪伴下，視障人士重新追尋失去的夢想，見證人犬情深，便能光明同行的故事.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 未來方案
programme.desc: 交通是人類生活中不可或缺的一部份，但交通運輸是最大的污染源之一，為了讓地球變得更健康，重塑未來運輸系統的競賽已經開始，從機器人的士、無人機超級公路、零碳超級燃料，到碳中和飛行以及重新思考現時的生活方式，令我們發現一個令人期待的新未來。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2024年10月14日 星期一晚上10時30分.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 大腦解碼
programme.desc: 著名物理學家占．艾爾─卡利里(Jim Al-Khalili)帶領觀眾跨越六億年，探索人腦——這宇宙中已知最複雜的結構——是如何誕生。從最奇異的史前生物，到最早登陸的動物、靈長類，再到人類，見證大腦如何逐步演化出千億神經元及過百兆個連結，塑造了獨特的大腦形態，並賦予我們語言的天才。本系列以尖端科學與淺白解說，在人工智慧時代反思人類大腦的獨特之處，揭示人之所以為人的故事.

programme.title: 大自然大不同 自然力
programme.sub-title: 大自然大不同之自然力
programme.desc: 在大自然中，覓食與求生，以及求偶和繁衍，都是所有生物的重要課題。 瀕危的黑臉琵鷺在香港尋得一處覓食天堂，得以大快朵頤；反觀極為罕見、在香港只有兩次出沒紀錄的草原鵰難得過境，卻在北部的漁塘覓食和補給時，遭到本地留鳥襲擊。成千上萬的斑蝶羣聚於山谷過冬，在遇上飢餓的獵食者黃腳胡蜂時，又能否安然度過冬天？ 春夏交替之時，各個物種都忙於繁衍後代，盧氏小樹蛙在樹林中鳴叫求偶，山椒鳥夫婦合力築巢，而鳳頭鷹的雛鳥才剛剛出生。各個物種都為繁衍後代而努力，當中的故事有成功有失敗。 紀錄物種︰黑臉琵鷺、反嘴鷸、白腰杓鷸、灰斑鴴、草原鵰、度冬斑蝶、橙腹葉鵯、赤紅山椒鳥、鳳頭鷹、盧氏小樹蛙、印度側異腹胡蜂及黑翅長腳鷸.

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：李靜帶着行李離開
programme.desc: 早上夢安發現李靜已經帶着行李離開，她責怪李臨不該這樣對姐姐，傷了她的心。夢安打電話給李靜，李靜說她想回家看看歐陽。地產公司外的一家咖啡廳，婉真把自己準備好的客戶資料留給了菲菲，讓菲菲做好房屋銷售.

programme.title: 念
programme.desc: 器官捐贈微電影《念》，講述一位母親為離世兒子捐出器官時，所經歷嘅思念與抉擇，以及捐出兒子器官後，見證到受贈者與家屬重獲新生而萌生的全新體會。希望透過微電影鼓勵大眾踏出重要一步，支持器官捐贈，讓受贈者及他們的家人得到第二人生.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 無極飛行
programme.sub-title: 無極飛行第九集：澳洲 - 灌木林機師
programme.desc: Clark Butson在澳洲的乾旱沙漠中創建了一家航空公司，希望連結位於國家西部皮爾布拉省的偏遠社群。在這裏，飛機是與外界連繫的唯一方式。C lark的任務種類繁多：拯救行動、搭載學生、補給、礦場員工換班、探訪原住民社區等等。Clark亦會協助牧民趕牛。他們要在數百平方公里的灌木叢中，將數千隻牛集合在一起，是個非常大規模的行動。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年11月20日 星期一晚上10時30分 Clark Butson founded an airline in the heart of Australia's arid desert. Its goal: to unite the isolated communities of the province of Pilbara, in the west of the country. Here, the airplane is the only link with the rest of the world. And Clark has a lot to do to on his missions. Rescues, student transportation, supplies, rotations between mines, visiting aboriginal communities. Clark also helps farmers during "mustering," a massive operation to gather their thousands of cattle scattered over hundreds of kilometers in the bush. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.11.20 MON 10:30pm.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.sub-title: 大潭郊野公园的日与夜
programme.desc: 人生活的地方，可以和自然环境靠近。这是大潭郊野公园的其中一个特色。. 其实，大潭郊野公园位于港岛东部，面积占香港岛的五分之一。内有四个水塘，由一条大潭水务文物径连系。. 沿着文物径，当中不少的水务设施，都已经被评定为法定古迹。例如由花岗石建造的石桥和水坝，都有过百年历史.

programme.title: 奀菇菇搞搞震 2 - 難忘的一天
programme.desc: 杏鮑仔有一種不祥的預感。他總覺得自己忘了某件至關重要的事。當記憶的碎片終於拼湊完整，他明白了那股不安的源頭——菇菇鎮即將遭受一群飢餓木蟲的侵襲！築起防禦工程！我們必須拯菇菇鎮.

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.desc: A)緋緋被挑選在全校音樂會中，擔任她班別的獨唱代表。她興奮得不斷地練習，但在表演當天早上卻發現失了聲，聲音變得沙啞，她能否在音樂會中表演呢？. B)緋緋、莉莉及彼得原本計劃跟心愛的娃娃一起到公園爬山。但莉莉的娃娃的手臂卻破爛了，緋緋自告奮勇幫忙修補，最後兩人更變身成紅粉村的娃娃醫生，在後園的樹屋中開了娃娃醫院，修補破爛的娃娃。可憐彼得一等再等，都無法出發去爬山。. 播放頻道： 港台電視31 播出時間： (首播) 2021年4月25日 星期日 上午9時00分 (重播) 2021年4月25日 星期日 下午6時30分 (重播) 2021年5月1日 星期六 下午6時30分 (網上重溫) 至 2022年4月24日 星期日 . A) Pinkalicious is chosen to sing a solo in a class concert. She practices and practices to make sure she gets the solo just right, but on the morning of the performance she discovers she’s lost her voice! How will she be able to sing?. B) Pinkalicious, Jasmine and Peter love playing with their dolls. When one of their dolls gets hurt, the fun doesn’t end – instead, the game changes to playing doctor! Soon, Pinkalicious and Jasmine find themselves taking care of all the dolls in Pinkville while Peter feels a little left out. . Channel: RTHK 31 Time: (First Run) 2021.4.25 SUN 9:00am (Re-run) 2021.4.25 SUN 6:30pm (Re-run) 2021.5.1 SAT 6:30pm (On-line Catch-up) Till 2022.4.24 SUN.

programme.title: 冰球少年
programme.desc: 沈冰冰惦記趙大龍入隊與冷靖對質後穿幫，又聯繫不上陳徹，一氣之下假扮外賣員找到陳徹，一番交流，沈冰冰覺得這件事可以被蒙混過去。冷靖偷點外賣被陳宥斌發現，並指責陳宥斌的訓練方針不科學。陳宥斌與隊員們進行比試，與隊員們打成一片。沈舟舟確診焦慮症.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第十五集: 總行偏私郝偉負責的支行
programme.desc: 莫惜君帶著花羽銀行的外方領導與林強談判，對方再次詢問，這項合作到底有沒有得到聯眾銀行高層領導的支持。總行多次給郝偉負責的支行優惠政策，在行政上特事特辦，導致兩家支行位於同一條街，卻給客戶提供不同的收益，引起其他支行對郝偉的不滿.

programme.title: 前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第十六集: 詐騙貸款與董事長邢禮有關
programme.desc: 錢才的太太發現了錢才留下的文件，立即去找林強，林強查看了，發現汶琥集團的貸款竟然是與董事長邢禮有關!邢禮親自來到龍源給兩家支行開會，郝偉強調龍源不該存在惡性競爭，應該合並兩家支行，林強不服，認為還沒到三個月的期限，應當遵守信用。祝豐山當眾支持林強.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 於本集中，我們會盤點動物王國中最具魅力的野生動物家族。從人類的表親——靈長類寶寶，到最可愛迷人的貓科動物家族，再到地球上色彩繽紛的鳥類家族。跟我們一起探索這些不可思議動物的生活點滴吧.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 海鸚們在雪地裡發現了一輛被棄置的雪橇後，為了誰人先乘坐而爭吵起來。可是，他們並不知道還有其他「人」也想玩這個雪橇⋯⋯.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 在一場雪球大戰中，佩佩和德仔被奧圖的徽章催眠了。迪迪和小特能否找到方法拯救他們的朋友呢.

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：錢副總突襲婉真
programme.desc: 錢副總突襲婉真，路過的俞辰挺身而出，救下婉真。婉真深表感激。俞辰告訴婉真，為了安全，建議她在陽台上掛幾件男士衣服，婉真笑了出來。許夢安回到家，看到冰箱裏李靜大姐包的幾百個餛飩，頗感溫暖.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 大熊貓雲川和鑫寶
programme.desc: 雄性大熊貓雲川今年5歲，必殺技是「吃」，最愛躺着吃，沒有任何一根筍能逃出雲川的嘴巴。住在雲川隔壁的是4歲的雌性大熊貓鑫寶，因為需要大量啃食竹子，一個領地裏，多一張嘴都可能導致食物不夠，所以大熊貓有極強的領地意識.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 大熊貓雲川和鑫寶
programme.desc: 自1996年，大熊貓白雲入住加州聖地亞哥動物園20多年，牠以其獨特魅力迅速成為動物園罕見的鎮園之寶。無疑備受期待的雲川和鑫寶，也將成為聖地亞哥新的超級明星。為了迎接熊貓的到來，聖地亞哥動物園正在改造原有的熊貓館.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 本集從定義何謂「冒險」出發，探討從離開舒適圈、計算風險到追尋自我的心理歷程。節目透過分享各人深刻的冒險故事——從荒野露營、挑戰畏高到孤身赴日發展，剖析冒險中的得失與自我發現。我們更以神奇的魔術表演為引，反思當「知曉秘密」後，人如何持續追尋生命的驚喜與真實。最終，我們將冒險的意義從宏大的生命轉折，延伸至日常中不計劃的旅行與微小突破。. 主持:. 陳葦璇(歌手). 林家濠(哲學講師). 李澄琳(澳洲註冊營養師). 馮孟成(魔術師).

programme.sub-title: 第二十六集：錢副總突襲婉真
programme.desc: 錢副總突襲婉真，路過的俞辰挺身而出，救下婉真。婉真深表感激。俞辰告訴婉真，為了安全，建議她在陽台上掛幾件男士衣服，婉真笑了出來。許夢安回到家，看到冰箱裏李靜大姐包的幾百個餛飩，頗感溫暖.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了香港觀鳥會高級項目主任梁浩男，分享有關秧鷄的生態知識。本集以白胸苦惡鳥、紫水鷄和鳳頭麥鷄作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索秧鷄的外貌特徵、食性、以及生活習性.

programme.title: 灣區夢成真
programme.desc: 高中組（趙聿修紀念中學）學生設計的大灣區行程，開展Day 1與Day 2行程，探索廣州佛山文化與科技，通過遊戲與資訊展現大灣區的傳統與現代.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第六集：劉銘巨額債務令羅英子崩潰
programme.desc: 王大福案的受害人家屬因未能獲判賠償，到大正律師事務所大吵大鬧，要求退款。為了不想失去這宗案件，薜律師和陳碩表示會為他們找出真兇，爭取賠償。另一邊，羅英子把公婆住的房子賣給了周老闆，並要求他們搬離房子，然而此時又再得悉劉銘在外還借了巨額債務，頓時崩潰.

前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第十七集: 林強與銀行創辦人見面表達信念
programme.desc: 陳行遠打算把林強調回總行接替錢才的位置，但是林強依然打算堅持三個月的約定。陳行遠帶著林強去見聯眾銀行創辦人邱之彰，林強向他表達自己的信念。聯眾銀行和花羽銀行重大的簽約儀式正式舉行，邢禮用會議絆住了陳行遠和祝豐山，沒法參加簽約儀式，眼看合作陷入危機.

programme.title: 前途無量
programme.sub-title: 第十八集：邢禮和陳行遠撕破臉
programme.desc: 林強請邱之彰去參加簽約儀式。邱老認為不符合規矩，林強說出和花羽銀行的合作有些激進，但只要在規則的範圍之下，可以開創金融界的新領域。邢禮找陳行遠談話，兩人徹底撕破臉。邢禮希望兩人各退一步，然而陳行遠沒有收手的打算，他篤定邢禮的手不乾淨.

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 於本集中，我們會盤點動物王國中最具魅力的野生動物家族。從人類的表親——靈長類寶寶，到最可愛迷人的貓科動物家族，再到地球上色彩繽紛的鳥類家族。跟我們一起探索這些不可思議動物的生活點滴吧.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 迪迪假裝自己肚子痛得厲害，朋友們憂心忡忡，決定帶她去找尊尼。然而，尊尼並沒有被她騙到，更想出辦法令她不再裝病.

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 佩佩遇見了奧圖手下一隻壞脾氣的海鸚皮夫，但出乎意料的是，這兩隻海鸚之間竟然擦出了愛火花.

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第二十七集：許父來到小西瓜的百天宴
programme.desc: 在小西瓜百天宴當天，許父也來到夢心所在的月子會所為她慶祝。可惜熊熊生病去了醫院，本應熱鬧的百天宴變得了無生氣。夢心看到父親蒼老的樣子，夢心忍不住痛哭。許父雖說不出話，但仍努力安撫女兒，不希望她再自責.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 為人民服務
programme.sub-title: 為人民服務 - 天文台 - 大帽山新雷達儀器

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.desc: 蕭欣浩，中文系博士兼講師，專研飲食文化。他中學會考得六分，但自小愛吃愛煮，對美食的觸覺可謂滿分。為了追尋飲食夢，他年輕時曾經當法國餐廳廚師，但他的追夢歷程並不止於此。當了廚師一年後，他決定重投校園，花十年時間當上中文系博士，其後鑽研飲食文化及歷史，將飲食夢的舞台轉移至校園，甚至延伸至社區，透過電視節目、講座、專欄、著書等，實現夢想2.0 —傳承飲食文化。. 這一集，我們一邊跟著蕭博士吃吃喝喝，一邊投入他的飲食文化多元宇宙.

programme.title: 無所畏懼 (第一季)
programme.sub-title: 第七集：方麗虹成為羅英子代理律師
programme.desc: 羅英子再發現劉銘把她住的房子抵押給銀行及欠下巨額貸款。羅英子來到方麗虹辦公室，請求方麗虹能為她這件案子出山，方麗虹最終答應。然而，韓之通反對，認為應該開除羅英子。此時，王大福親自來感謝羅英子幫他查明案件，羅英子從中得知韓之通收下了王大福的感謝費.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 為人民服務
programme.sub-title: 為人民服務 - 天文台 - 大帽山新雷達儀器

programme.title: 31看世界 - 魅力阿聯酋
programme.sub-title: 第二集：多元化的繽紛魅力
programme.desc: 因為得天獨厚的地理位置，阿聯酋在歷史上始終與世界保持著貿易往來。今天，它與全球的聯繫更日益緊密。. 隨著阿聯酋航空業的發展，越來越多的外籍人士來到阿聯酋生活，多元文化在此彙聚。法國之外的全球唯一一所盧浮宮博物館帶來了頂級文化盛宴，F1大獎賽等世界級體育賽事讓這裡充滿速度與激情。. 引入機器人騎手參賽的駱駝比賽，充滿包容性的傳統樂器烏德琴，使阿聯酋在擁抱全球多元文化的同時，始終傳承著自己的文化根基。. 中阿兩國在歷史上就已經開始交往，如今，在兩國建交40周年之際，兩國合作項目如雨後春筍般湧現。在密切的交流合作中，中國和阿聯酋正攜手開創全新的未來.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 一位曾任職管理層的職場女性羅欣妮(Annie)，因後天眼疾導致視力僅餘一成，被迫在黑暗中重新尋找人生與事業的方向。然而，漫長的求職路上，社會的刻板印象與不理解曾讓她感到束手無策，直到她遇見了現職的人力資源服務公司，這個將共融視為公司文化的企業，令她成功重返職場。. 吳海昕(Sofiee)將在 Annie 的帶領下，親身體驗視障人士學習職場技能的挑戰，並深入了解 Annie 如何從失落中尋求支援、重拾職場價值的心路歷程。這不單是關於 Annie 個人堅韌成長的故事，更是一場關於企業如何帶頭推廣職場接納、發掘潛能、並在業界樹立共融典範的深刻對話，透過實際行動，打破職場藩籬.

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: 2023 marked the 10th anniversary of the Belt and Road Initiative, with Hong Kong actively stepping up its role to showcase its unique strengths to Belt and Road countries. Chief Executive John Lee led a delegation to the Middle East, signing 13 memorandums of understanding with Middle Eastern nations to promote the development of green and smart cities in the region. . The government is leading efforts to open up the Middle Eastern market, encouraging Hong Kong businesses to seize opportunities in the region’s green economy. Jeffrey Lam, Executive Council member and founder of the non-profit Hong Kong Ambassadors Club, along withPatrick Tsang, organized two delegations of businesses from various sectors to meet with Middle Eastern political and business leaders. These exchanges resulted in several memorandums of understanding being signed between Hong Kong companies and their Middle Eastern counterparts, including Grade A Energy Limited, Green Mondy, and Rice Robotics, opening the door for green businesses to enter the Middle Eastern market, and sharing Hong Kong’s green technologies with local enterprises. . Meanwhile, Hong Kong Science Park has played a key role in opening up the Middle Eastern market, leading eight tech companies to participate in a large-scale technology exhibition in Saudi Arabia. This showcased Hong Kong’s strengths in green technology. Among them, a startup focused on electric vehicle charging solutions connected with potential local customers during the event, strengthening its confidence in exploring opportunities in the region. . What challenges and opportunities have they faced while venturing into the Middle Eastern green market.

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 梅曉歌召開醫改專項調度會，直面醫改中沒改好、越改越差的具體問題。林志為書記主持圍爐夜話，幫村民解決問題。長嶺村陸續有村民生病，林志為是水質污染的問題，測出水裡的重金屬嚴重超標，涉及到九原縣昶勝礦業的污染問題.

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 梅曉歌為村民檢查身體，同時去找曹立新解決昶勝礦業的污染問題。曹立新卻因為昶勝礦業能成為市內第一家上市企業，不肯解決問題。林志為走訪了礦產企業所在的九原縣蓮花鄉，瞭解了鄉民受污染所害的情況，建議長嶺村的村民們聯合起來，以集體訴訟的方式獲取應得的賠償.
